licenses.attribution: World English Bible (WEB), 2020 stable text edition, eBible.org, https://ebible.org/engwebp/. "World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org.
licenses.note: eBible.org asks that a changed text no longer be called the World English Bible: a patch that changes its words must also take that name out of this attribution.
licenses.text:
Public domain.

The World English Bible's copyright page (https://ebible.org/engwebp/copyright.htm) says:
"The World English Bible is in the Public Domain. That means that it is not copyrighted."
Its only condition concerns the name: if the text is changed, the result is not to be called the
World English Bible. "World English Bible" is a trademark of eBible.org.

eBible.org publishes it from the United States. The page states no restriction on AI or machine
learning use.

held_out_by.note: eBible's chapter files, <code>_<NNN>_<BOOK>_<CC>_read.txt, are held out by book and chapter, so the same chapter is held out in every translation at once (maintainer's decision, 2026-10-23)

note: eBible.org rebuilds this zip often; the checksum covers the files inside, so a rebuild with the same text still matches.
